_doc:
Explicit (fixture, schema) pairs the smoke pass validates. Add a new entry whenever a fixture's schema is decided. Two binding styles:
  • schema_file       — path to a standalone JSON Schema (under atlases/genome/registries/schemas/schema_out/ etc.)
  • inline_from_page  — path to a page HTML + schema_index (0-based ga-schema-block index on that page).
The check skips silently if jsonschema isn't installed (stdlib-only local runs still pass); CI installs jsonschema so the check is enforced there.

pairs._doc: Chapter 5 consolidated TE envelope — the single fetch page_comparative_te reads. Validates against the inline draft-2020-12 schema on the page itself (block 0; block 1 is the BED format spec, not JSON).
